nodes.description: _owner private address holding the contract owner, set from msg.sender in Ownable constructor
mapping(address=>uint256) _rOwned internal reflection balances
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances ERC20 allowances
mapping(address=>bool) _isExcludedFromFee fee exemption set
_rTotal total reflection supply decreased on every fee
bool tradingOpen gate that restricts non-owner transfers
bool inSwap reentrancy guard used by lockTheSwap modifier
bool swapEnabled toggles automatic swap-and-send in _transfer
_maxTxAmount max tokens transferable per transaction
IUniswapV2Router02 external router used for token/ETH swaps
address of the SATINU/WETH Uniswap pair
mapping(address=>bool) bots blacklist checked in _transfer
payable development address authorized for manualswap/manualsend
payable marketing address receiving ETH fees
public ERC20 transfer, calls _transfer with _msgSender() as from
public ERC20 transferFrom, moves tokens then decrements allowance
public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve
private _transfer core logic: limits, blacklist, trading gate and auto-liquidity swap
private swapTokensForEth calls router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens under lockTheSwap
private sendETHToFee forwards ETH to _marketingAddress via transfer
external manualswap callable by development or marketing address
external manualsend callable by development or marketing address
onlyOwner setTrading toggles tradingOpen
onlyOwner setFee updates buy/sell tax and redis fee state vars
private _transferStandard performs reflection accounting and emits Transfer
private _tokenTransfer conditionally removes/restores fees then calls _transferStandard
onlyOwner blockBots blacklists an array of addresses
onlyOwner unblockBot removes an address from blacklist
private _approve writes allowance mapping and emits Approval
onlyOwner setMaxTxnAmount updates _maxTxAmount
onlyOwner excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees updates _isExcludedFromFee for a list
msg.sender attacker-controlled caller identity used for transfers, approvals and authorization checks
block.timestamp used as swap deadline in swapTokensForEth
external call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with attacker-influenceable deadline
external ETH transfer _marketingAddress.transfer(amount) inside fee distribution
recipient address parameter of transfer
from address parameter of _transfer
to address parameter of _transfer
amount uint256 parameter of _transfer
tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth passed to router as amountIn
contractTokenBalance local in _transfer bounding the swap amount
canSwap local bool in _transfer gating automatic swap
takeFee local bool in _transfer determining fee removal
contractETHBalance local in _transfer used to trigger sendETHToFee

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the from argument of _transfer, letting the caller control the debited account path
transfer passes _msgSender() as sender into _transfer
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender when reducing allowance
approve uses _msgSender() as owner of the allowance
_approve owner argument derives from msg.sender callers
manualswap require(_msgSender()==development||marketing) authorization depends on caller
manualsend require(_msgSender()==development||marketing) authorization depends on caller
_owner is initialized from _msgSender() in the constructor and reassigned in transferOwnership
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline making execution miner/timestamp dependent
external router call can reenter the token contract before state settles
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth mid-transfer while balances and fees are being mutated
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which pushes ETH to an external address
sendETHToFee performs the _marketingAddress.transfer external ETH send
_transfer delegates final token movement to _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard to apply reflection accounting
_transferStandard mutates _rOwned[sender] and _rOwned[recipient] with sub/add
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal using SafeMath sub during _transferStandard
transfer calls _transfer
transferFrom calls _transfer before adjusting allowance
approve calls _approve
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from _allowances via SafeMath sub
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount and caps the swap amount
_transfer requires tradingOpen true for non-owner senders
_transfer requires !bots[from] && !bots[to] before proceeding
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to select buy/sell fees
_transfer reads inSwap before triggering the swap and lockTheSwap writes it
_transfer checks swapEnabled before auto-swapping
_transfer checks _isExcludedFromFee[from]/[to] to decide takeFee
setTrading writes tradingOpen and is protected by onlyOwner
blockBots writes bots[]=true for each address, onlyOwner gated
unblockBot writes bots[notbot]=false, onlyOwner gated
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFee entries, onlyOwner gated
setMaxTxnAmount writes _maxTxAmount, onlyOwner gated
_developmentAddress is an authorized caller of manualswap
_marketingAddress is an authorized caller of manualsend
_owner is compared to _msgSender() by the onlyOwner modifier guarding setTrading
_transfer calls owner() to bypass limits and the trading gate for the owner
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router to approve and execute the swap
contractTokenBalance is passed as tokenAmount into the swap
canSwap condition decides whether swapTokensForEth is invoked
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee
takeFee boolean is passed into _tokenTransfer controlling fee removal
recipient parameter flows into the _transfer destination
from parameter drives balance debiting and blacklist/pair checks
to parameter drives balance crediting and wallet-size check
amount parameter drives limit checks and reflection math
tokenAmount parameter is the amountIn of the router swap

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only used by transfer to supply the _transfer destination, fold it into the transfer function node
from is a local parameter of _transfer, merge it into the _transfer function node
to is a local parameter of _transfer, merge it into the _transfer function node
amount is a local parameter of _transfer, merge it into the _transfer function node
tokenAmount is the swap input parameter of swapTokensForEth, merge into that function
contractTokenBalance is a local computed inside _transfer, merge into _transfer
canSwap is a local boolean inside _transfer controlling the auto-swap, merge into _transfer
takeFee is passed from _transfer into _tokenTransfer to gate fee removal, merge into _tokenTransfer
contractETHBalance is the ETH amount forwarded to sendETHToFee, merge into sendETHToFee
